budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Two teams relay a physical token through space. An allied in-flight catch arms scoring; carry the armed token onto your three-cell target goal.
task.natural_termination: The first armed-token carried goal naturally ends play; otherwise horizon 96 truncates. Natural completion at the horizon takes priority.
task.interaction: Each possession permits only two successful carrier moves and drops after four held ticks. Cardinal throws advance a real token one tile per transition. Teammate receiving and opponent guarding extend contact reach; interceptions and adjacent tackles reset goal arming. Bodies block each other routes.
task.observation_access: Fully observable public map, every player and token position/velocity/possession/timer, goals, scores and actual event flags. All entity masks are true; each float32 feature is an integer divided by 128.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Actual scored goals in team order
Roles that actually threw the held token this step
Roles that actually caught an airborne or loose token this step
Roles that caught an opposing in-flight pass this step
Roles that stole an adjacent held token this step
Roles forced to drop by the four-tick holding limit
Teams that actually scored an armed-token goal this step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
